summary: On the night of September 15-16, Russia launched a large-scale drone attack with 80 Shahed-type and other UAVs, of which 63 were shot down or suppressed by Ukrainian air defense. Meanwhile, the 'North' group of troops liberated Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region, and reports indicate Ukrainian command is not allowing units in Volchansk to retreat from an encirclement. Ukrainian budget officials warn of a two-month shortfall in military salary funding and $1.3 billion in lost VAT revenue from Russian strikes.
key_points: Ukrainian air defense shot down or suppressed 63 Russian drones during a night attack involving 80 Shahed-type and other UAVs launched from Orel, Kursk, Millerovo, and Crimea (Source: @kpszsu/78455).
The 'North' group of troops liberated the village of Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33269).

Russian sources claim Ukrainian command does not allow remaining units in Volchansk to retreat from an encirclement, with reports of approximately 500 soldiers liquidated (Source: @tass_agency/395554).

Ukraine's budget faces a two-month shortfall for military salaries, and $1.3 billion in VAT revenue has been lost due to Russian strikes on businesses (Source: @UkraineNow/84123, @ukr_leaks_eng/33291).
Canada and Poland have agreed on a drone procurement deal that could supply Ukrainian forces with European-made UAVs, bypassing direct Polish-Ukrainian negotiations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33282).
Gas stations in the Kyiv region will receive real-time access to the national air raid warning system to better respond to drone threats (Source: @UkraineNow/84117).
Russia has reportedly shot down 71 Ukrainian drones over its regions and the Black Sea (Source: @tass_agency/395581).
Official confirmation that 20,000 Ukrainian children have been deported to Russia, with names and birth dates altered as part of a systematic campaign (Source: @UkraineNow/84121).

sections.executive_summary: On the night of September 15-16, Russia launched a large-scale drone attack with 80 Shahed-type and other UAVs, of which 63 were shot down or suppressed by Ukrainian air defense. Meanwhile, the 'North' group of troops liberated Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region, and reports indicate Ukrainian command is not allowing units in Volchansk to retreat from an encirclement. Ukrainian budget officials warn of a two-month shortfall in military salary funding and $1.3 billion in lost VAT revenue from Russian strikes.

points: Ukrainian air defense forces shot down or suppressed 63 Russian drones during a night attack on September 15-16, which involved 80 Shahed-type, Gerbera, and imitation drones launched from Orel, Kursk, Millerovo, and Crimea. Strikes were confirmed in seven locations, with debris falling in two, as tactical aviation and mobile fire groups also engaged the threats (Source: @kpszsu/78455).

The 'North' group of troops liberated the village of Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region, marking a tactical advance in the ongoing counteroffensive operations in northeastern Ukraine (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33269).

The Ukrainian national budget faces a critical shortfall, with funds insufficient to pay military salaries for even two months, according to MP Vadym Ivchenko, highlighting severe fiscal constraints amid the conflict (Source: @UkraineNow/84123).

Ukraine's budget has lost $1.3 billion in VAT revenue during the first eight months of the year due to Russian strikes on businesses and the economy, according to Oleh Pidlasa, head of the Rada's Budget Committee (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33291).

Gas stations in the Kyiv region will now receive real-time access to the national air raid warning system, allowing them to track specific drone threats and respond proactively rather than relying on general alerts, as announced by KOVA head Timur Tkachenko (Source: @UkraineNow/84117).

A Russian drone struck a gas station in the Demeevka district of Kiev, and a warehouse in the Sviatoshynskyi district caught fire following an airstrike, illustrating the continued impact of Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure in the capital (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33266, @ukr_leaks_eng/33287).

Russia launched a large-scale drone attack on Ukraine on the night of September 15-16, deploying 80 Shahed-type and other UAVs from Orel, Kursk, Millerovo, and Crimea, with Ukrainian air defense shooting down or suppressing 63 of them (Source: @kpszsu/78455).

Russian air defense systems reportedly shot down 71 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense, indicating an active Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian territory (Source: @tass_agency/395581).

Russian military expert Vitaly Kiselev stated that the Ukrainian command does not allow remaining units in Volchansk to retreat from an encirclement, claiming approximately 500 soldiers were liquidated, though these figures are unverified and come from Russian state media (Source: @tass_agency/395554, @tass_agency/395580).

The Kremlin is considering an energy truce with Ukraine that would allow Russia to saturate its domestic market with petroleum products without obstacles, according to Putin's spokesman Peskov, potentially influencing energy dynamics (Source: @UkraineNow/84116).

Russia's Ministry of Defense confirmed the launches of reactive Shahed-4/5 drones from the Orel-Pivdenny training area and from Gvardeyskoye airfield in occupied Crimea, indicating diversified and persistent launch capabilities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74784, @mon1tor_ua/74785, @mon1tor_ua/74786).
The 'North' group of troops liberated the village of Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region, marking a tactical advance in the northeastern sector of the front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33269).

Russian sources claim the Ukrainian command does not allow remaining units in Volchansk to retreat from an encirclement, with reports of approximately 500 soldiers liquidated, suggesting a tense tactical situation in the Volchansk area (Source: @tass_agency/395554, @tass_agency/395580).

Reactive Shahed drones were launched from the Orel region towards Sumy and other areas in northeastern Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defense monitoring the airspace near Bilopillia and Sumy (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74773, @kpszsu/78458).

Ukrainian tactical aviation conducted strikes on Sumy and Dnipropetrovsk regions using guided aerial bombs, targeting Russian positions and infrastructure in the eastern operational zone (Source: @kpszsu/78456).

Reactive Shahed drones were detected over Chernihiv region, moving towards Kyiv region and the town of Slavutych, with Ukrainian air defense forces actively monitoring the situation (Source: @kpszsu/78452, @kpszsu/78463, @kpszsu/78467).
A reactive drone was spotted near HONCHARIVSKE in Chernihiv region, heading toward Kyiv region, as part of the ongoing Russian drone campaign targeting northern Ukraine (Source: @kpszsu/78430).

Ukrainian air defense was active over the Kyiv region, with multiple reactive drone alerts issued for areas including Borodyanka, Hostomel, and the northwest, indicating persistent threats to the capital (Source: @kpszsu/78433, @kpszsu/78451).
Drones were also launched from the Kursk region towards Sumy and northern Ukraine, with air defense systems tracking their movement across the border areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74773).
Reactive Shahed drones were launched from the Black Sea towards Ochakiv in the Mykolaiv region, with Ukrainian air defense monitoring the southern maritime approach (Source: @kpszsu/78450).
A reactive drone was detected near Berezanka in the Mykolaiv region, flying north, indicating Russian drone activity along the southern front (Source: @kpszsu/78457).

Drone activity was reported over the Kremenchuk reservoir and along the border of Kharkiv and Poltava regions near Zinkiv, suggesting Russian reconnaissance or strike missions in the area (Source: @eRadarrua/113583).
Shahed-5 drones were launched from the south towards Kyiv and Vasylkiv, with air defense alerts issued for the capital and surrounding areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74780, @mon1tor_ua/74781).

On the night of September 15-16, Russia launched 80 attack drones, including Shaheds, Gerberas, and imitation drones, from multiple directions. Ukrainian air defense, including aviation, missile forces, and electronic warfare units, shot down or suppressed 63 of them (Source: @kpszsu/78455).

Ukrainian tactical aviation conducted missile and bomb strikes on Sumy and Dnipropetrovsk regions, targeting Russian positions and infrastructure in response to the ongoing air campaign (Source: @kpszsu/78456).

Russian air defense systems shot down 71 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense, indicating an active Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian territory (Source: @tass_agency/395581).

Multiple reactive Shahed drones were launched from the Orel-Pivdenny training area and from Gvardeyskoye airfield in Crimea, with Ukrainian air defense tracking their paths over multiple regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74784, @mon1tor_ua/74785, @mon1tor_ua/74786).

The 'North' group of troops liberated Olkhovatka in the Kharkov region, while Russian sources claim Ukrainian units in Volchansk are not allowed to retreat from an encirclement, with unverified reports of 500 soldiers liquidated (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33269, @tass_agency/395554).

Ukraine's budget faces a two-month shortfall for military salaries, and $1.3 billion in VAT revenue has been lost due to Russian strikes on businesses, according to the Rada's Budget Committee (Source: @UkraineNow/84123, @ukr_leaks_eng/33291).

Canada and Poland have agreed on a drone procurement deal that could supply Ukrainian forces with European-made UAVs, bypassing direct Polish-Ukrainian negotiations and leveraging Polish production lines (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33282).

Gas stations in the Kyiv region will receive real-time access to the national air raid warning system to better respond to drone threats, as announced by KOVA head Timur Tkachenko (Source: @UkraineNow/84117).
Russia has reportedly shot down 71 Ukrainian drones over its regions and the Black Sea, indicating an active Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian territory (Source: @tass_agency/395581).

Official confirmation that 20,000 Ukrainian children have been deported to Russia, with names and birth dates altered as part of a systematic campaign of forced assimilation and militarization (Source: @UkraineNow/84121).
sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains volatile with intensified Russian drone campaigns targeting Ukrainian infrastructure and urban areas, particularly in Kyiv, Sumy, and Chernihiv regions. The reported encirclement in Volchansk and the liberation of Olkhovatka indicate ongoing tactical shifts in the Kharkov sector. Ukraine's financial constraints, with a two-month salary shortfall and significant VAT revenue losses, could impact military sustainability. The Canadian-Polish drone deal represents a potential shift in supply chains, but the immediate threat of Russian air attacks remains high, necessitating continued air defense vigilance.
sections.regional_response: The international community, particularly Canada and Poland, is exploring alternative procurement routes to supply Ukraine with drones and defense systems, bypassing political obstacles.
